full_judgment: 9. In the case of Habibur Rahman Mollah vs State reported in 62 DLR (AD) 233 the Appellant Division affirmed the observation made by this Court in a case under section 561A of the Code of Criminal Procedure that the period of limitation for enquiry or investigation as provided in the Anti-Corruption Commission Act and the Rules framed thereunder were directory in nature, that the time limit provided in Rule 10 of the Anti-Corruption Commission Rules for conclusion of investigation and section 6A of the Criminal Law Amendment Act 1958 for conclusion of trial are directory in nature.
